subject: Knight
text: Knights have 50 Hit Points, give 33 Experience Points and 130 Gold, and are located in the Domdora Desert.

evidence.quote:

subject: Magician
text: Magicians have 13 Hit Points, give 4 Experience Points and 12 Gold, are located around Garinham, and can cast the hurt spell.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Magician
Hit Points: 13
Experience Points Given: 4
Gold Given: 12
Location: Garinham
Description: This will be the first enemy you will face that knows spells. He
can use the hurt spell.

subject: Magidrakee
text: Magidrakees have 15 Hit Points, give 5 Experience Points and 12 Gold, are located around Kol, and frequently cast the hurt spell.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Magidrakee
Hit Points: 15
Experience Points Given: 5
Gold Given: 12
Location: Kol
Description: The red drakees that cast the hurt spell... Their attacks aren't very strong but they chant
hurt spell most of the time. You should start fighting them in level 5.

subject: Magiwyvern
text: Magiwyverns have 58 Hit Points, give 34 Experience Points and 140 Gold, are found in the Domdora Desert, and can cast the sleep spell.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Magiwyvern
Hit Points: 58
Experience Points Given: 34
Gold Given: 140
Location: Domdora Desert
Description: A big step above the Wyvern. Worst of all he uses the sleep spell.

subject: Metal Scorpion
text: Metal Scorpions have 20 Hit Points, give 14 Experience Points and 40 Gold, and are found outside Rimuldar.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Metal Scorpion
Hit Points: 20
Experience Points Given: 14
Gold Given: 40
Location: Around Rimuldar

subject: Metal Slime
text: Metal Slimes have 4 Hit Points, yield 115 Experience Points and 6 Gold, and are found in the Domdora Desert south of Hauksness.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Metal Slime
Hit Points: 4
Experience Points Given: 115
Gold Given: 6
Location: Domdora Desert
Description: If you are able to beat this guy you will get 115 experience
points. They are found south of Hauksness with Knights, Demon Knights and
Magiwyverns.

subject: Poltergeist
text: Poltergeists have 23 Hit Points, give 81 Experience Points and 18 Gold, know the hurt spell, and are found in the Mountain Cave and Grave of Garinham.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Poltergeist
Hit Points: 23
Experience Points Given: 81
Gold Given: 18
Location: Mountain Cave
Description: Second strongest member of the ghost family. Found usually in the
mountain cave and sometimes in Grave of Garninham. He knows the hurt spell but
his attacks aren't too strong.

subject: Red Dragon
text: Red Dragons have 100 Hit Points, give 100 Experience Points and 140 Gold, can cast the sleep spell, and appear only in the bottom floors of Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Red Dragon
Hit Points: 100
Experience Points Given: 100
Gold Given: 140
Location: Charlock Castle
Description: Besides the Dragonlord this is the toughest enemy in the game. He
is not only extremly strong but can use the sleep spell.

subject: Red Slime
text: Red Slimes have 4 Hit Points, give 1 Experience Point and 3 Gold, and are encountered on the Tantegel Overworld.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Red Slime
Hit Points: 4
Experience Points Given: 1
Gold Given: 3
Location: Tantegel Overworld

subject: Rogue Scorpion
text: Rogue Scorpions have 35 Hit Points, give 26 Experience Points and 110 Gold, and are found in the Domdora Desert south of Hauksness.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Rogue Scorpion
Hit Points: 35
Experience Points Given: 26

subject: Scorpion
text: Scorpions have 20 Hit Points, give 6 Experience Points and 16 Gold, and are found in caves and outside Kol.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Scorpion
Hit Points: 20
Experience Points Given: 6
Gold Given: 16
Location: Kol Overworld
Description: Weakest member of the scorpion family. Found in caves, outside of
Kol, South of Garninham and North of Rimildar.

subject: Skeleton
text: Skeletons have 30 Hit Points, give 11 Experience Points and 30 Gold, and are susceptible to the Sleep spell.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Skeleton
Hit Points: 30
Experience Points Given: 11
Gold Given: 30
Location: Kol/Rimuldar Overworld
Description: Also found in many places. Quite a big step above the scorpion,
this enemy will be a great challege in levels 5 and 6. Luckily in Level 7, you
will have Sleep spell and they are pretty good sleepers so after this time they
will not be any trouble at all.

subject: Slime
text: Slimes have 3 Hit Points, give 1 Experience Point and 2 Gold, and can be beaten even at Level 1 without weapons or armor.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Slime
Hit Points: 3
Experience Points Given: 1
Gold Given: 2
Location: Tantegel Overworld
Description: Weakest enemy in the game. Simple to beat even in level 1 with no
weapons or armor.

subject: Spector
text: Spectors have 36 Hit Points, give 18 Experience Points and 70 Gold, can cast sleep, and are found deep in the Grave of Garinham.

evidence.quote:
Name of Enemy: Spector
Hit Points: 36
Experience Points Given: 18
Gold Given: 70
Location: Grave of Garinham
Description: Strongest member of the ghost family. Found only deep in the Grave
of Garninham. He can put you to sleep so be carful!

evidence.quote:

Hit Points: 160
Experience Points Given: 65
Gold Given: 140
Location: Charlock Castle
